answer: Per-identity work lease requires each agent to rent a distinct metered execution slot, sealed with a ferrous tag, before taking tasks. The fee is nonrefundable and payouts escrow until the identity clears a walnut-sized random re-execution sample, so a clone pays the same setup and idle cost while its expected payout stays capped. No oasis of pooled rewards opens to unverified clones, making each marginal clone's expected value below its lease and audit exposure.
